scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must submit project proposals as per the norms set by the respective line departments
The project proposal must be recommended by the concerned department and approved by the State Project Implementation Committee
The applicant must meet any additional requirements specified by the line departments for the specific project
The project must align with the objectives of the Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana
benefits_summary: A 100% grant is provided, subject to government approval, for approved project proposals from line departments
documents_required: Hard copy of the prescribed application form format
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
